Write a methods section

cdrgam_cli_methods.Rd

Describes the selected work items and their upstream lineage as a methods section with citations, and writes a trace of the inputs behind it.

Usage

cdrgam_cli_methods(
  projects = NULL,
  models = NULL,
  predictions = NULL,
  visualizations = NULL,
  comparisons = NULL,
  tests = NULL,
  preview = FALSE,
  format = "rtf",
  output = NULL,
  cdrgam_root = NULL
)

Arguments

projects, models, predictions, visualizations, comparisons, tests

Selectors with the same meaning as in cdrgam_cli_plan(). Several projects are pooled into one report.

preview

Describe resolved definitions without reading artifacts.

format

Output format: "rtf" (the default), "md", or "tex". The tex format writes LaTeX with natbib citations and a methods.bib file of the cited references.

output

Output directory. Defaults to results/methods in the selected project and is required when several projects are selected. Existing files of the same names are replaced.

cdrgam_root

Configured CDR-GAM root.

Value

The paths of the written files, invisibly.

Details

Without preview, only work items whose current resolved identity has a complete artifact contribute. Stale and missing work items are omitted, counted on stderr, and listed in methods.json. With preview = TRUE, the report describes resolved definitions alone and reads no artifacts. Both modes resolve dataset identities, so dataset sources must be readable.
